card.name: Words just before "systemically" or "systemic"
card.fires_on: The word right before "systemic" or "systemically", such as "absorbed", "or", "with" or "into". It appears when topical, local or inhaled drugs are being contrasted with whole-body effects.

modes.label: Absorbed before systemically
modes.description: The word "absorbed" or "into" after a topical or inhaled drug, just ahead of "systemically".
modes.example: may be<< absorbed>> systemically. The same adverse reactions found

modes.label: Topical or local versus systemic
modes.description: A linking word such as "or" or "with" that joins a topical or local route to a systemic one.
modes.example: treat with appropriate local<< or>> systemic (i.e., oral) ant

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict "system" or "systemic" as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before "systemic" when a drug applied locally is said to reach the whole body.
